summary: The "partnership" between @glitch and @mozilla turned to out to be not much beyond the export tool. I asked if we could just get the project title and descriptions or mass export and was told nothing more would be done beyond the export tool.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: The "partnership" between @glitch and @mozilla turned to out to be not much beyond the export tool. I asked if we could just get the project title and descriptions or mass export and was told nothing more would be done beyond the export tool.
